column2: Branch Tier Master - All Functional, Boundary & Error Cases
[Happy Path] Verify successful creation of a standard Branch Tier with full valid data
column3:
1. Navigate to menu "Phân Cấp Chi Nhánh" (/branch-tiers).
2. Click button "+ Thêm Phân Cấp Mới".
3. Fill Tier Name: "Tier 1 - Cửa Hàng Flagship".
4. Fill Min Staff = 10, Max Staff = 30.
5. Fill Description, Conditions & Benefits.
6. Click "Lưu Phân Cấp".
column4: Modal closes; Success toast displayed: "Thêm mới phân cấp thành công!"; New tier appears in table with exact quotas (10 - 30 nhân sự).
column5: Account has Operations Admin role; /branch-tiers loaded.

column2: [Happy Path / Edge] Verify creating Tier with empty Max Staff (Unlimited) and Fixed Quota (Min == Max)
column3:
1. Open Tier modal, input Tier Name: "Tier Hub - Không Giới Hạn", Min Staff: 5, leave Max Staff blank -> Click "Lưu Phân Cấp".
2. Reopen modal, input Tier Name: "Tier Fixed", Min Staff: 8, Max Staff: 8 -> Click "Lưu Phân Cấp".
column4:
Both tiers saved successfully:
- Tier Hub saves Max as null; List renders Max as "Không giới hạn" (badge "5+").
- Tier Fixed saves with exact quota min=8, max=8 without error.

column2: [Validation] Verify validation for empty/overlength Tier Name and non-integer headcount inputs
column3:
1. Leave Tier Name blank (or whitespace) -> Click "Lưu Phân Cấp".
2. Enter a string of 150 characters into Tier Name (> 100 chars).
3. In Min/Max Staff, enter non-numeric chars ("abc#!") or decimal numbers (3.5, 7.8).
column4:
System blocks submission and displays inline errors:
- "Tên phân cấp không được để trống" / "Tên phân cấp tối đa 100 ký tự".
- Non-numeric rejected; "Số lượng nhân sự phải là số nguyên từ 0 trở lên".

column2: [Boundary & Logic] Verify negative headcount prevention and quota violation when Max < Min
column3:
1. In Tier modal, input valid Tier Name.
2. In Min Staff, enter negative number: -5 -> Click "Lưu Phân Cấp".
3. Set Min Staff = 15, Max Staff = 5 (Max < Min) -> Click "Lưu Phân Cấp".
column4:
Submission blocked with inline validation errors:
- "Số nhân sự tối thiểu phải từ 0 trở lên".
- "Số nhân sự tối đa không được nhỏ hơn số tối thiểu".

column2: [Conflict & Security] Verify duplicate tier name rejection (409), XSS protection, and modal cancel reset
column3:
1. Input duplicate Tier Name that already exists in DB -> Click "Lưu Phân Cấp".
2. Enter "<script>alert('XSS')</script>" in Tier Name & Description -> Click Save and inspect list.
3. Fill dirty data into fields then click Cancel / "X", then reopen modal.
column4:
- Server returns HTTP 409 Conflict: "Tên phân cấp đã tồn tại trong hệ thống".
- HTML/JS tags are sanitized and rendered as harmless plain text.
- Modal closes cleanly; form resets to blank pristine state upon reopening.
column5: At least 1 Tier exists in database.

column2: Branch Master Creation - All Functional, GPS & Boundary Cases
[Happy Path] Verify successful branch creation with Code, Name, Address, Tier, and default Geofence radius
column3:
1. Navigate to /branches and click "Thêm Chi Nhánh Mới".
2. Enter Code: "CH05", Name: "Cửa Hàng Hoàn Kiếm", Address: "15 Đinh Tiên Hoàng".
3. Select Tier 1, Pin GPS (21.0285, 105.8542), Radius = 100m.
4. Click "Lưu Chi Nhánh".
column4: Modal closes; Success toast displayed: "Thêm chi nhánh mới thành công!"; CH05 appears in branch table with green status "Hoạt động" and 100m radius.
column5: Account has Operations Admin role; At least 1 Tier exists.

column2: [Happy Path / Map] Verify Leaflet map picker synchronization (Address search & Pin drag updates coordinates)
column3:
1. In Branch Form modal, type "Hồ Con Rùa" into map search box.
2. Click search result and drag pin on map to a new location.
3. Verify Latitude & Longitude inputs automatically update in real-time.
column4: Map pans smoothly; Pin moves to chosen point; Coordinates text fields automatically synchronize with map pin position.
column5: Branch modal is open; Leaflet Map initialized.

column2: [Validation] Verify mandatory field requirements, minimum lengths, and branch code regex format
column3:
1. Open branch modal and click "Lưu Chi Nhánh" with all fields empty.
2. Enter Branch Code = "A" (1 char), Branch Name = "HN" (2 chars).
3. In Branch Code field, enter spaces or accented letters: "CH 01@!" or "HÀNỘI_01".
column4:
Submit blocked; Form displays inline errors:
- Mandatory field warnings for Code, Name, Address.
- "Mã chi nhánh tối thiểu 2 ký tự.", "Tên chi nhánh tối thiểu 3 ký tự.".
- "Mã chi nhánh chỉ được chứa chữ cái không dấu, số và dấu gạch ngang".

column2: [Boundary] Verify GPS coordinate out-of-bound errors and Geofence radius auto-clamping (<20m, >1000m)
column3:
1. In Latitude enter 95.5 (out of -90..90), Longitude enter 195.0 (out of -180..180).
2. Enter Geofence Radius = 5m (< 20m) -> Click Save and inspect payload.
3. Enter Geofence Radius = 5000m (> 1000m) -> Click Save and inspect payload.
column4:
- Validation errors: "Vĩ độ không hợp lệ (-90 đến 90)", "Kinh độ không hợp lệ (-180 đến 180)".
- Radius auto-clamping: values < 20m clamped to default 100m; values > 1000m clamped to 1000m.

column2: [Conflict & Security] Verify duplicate code rejection (409), XSS protection, and network error handling (500)
column3:
1. Enter duplicate Branch Code: "CH01" (already exists in DB) -> Click "Lưu Chi Nhánh".
2. Enter "<script>alert(1)</script>" in Name & Address -> Save and verify table/popup.
3. Disconnect network or simulate 500 Internal Server Error when saving.
column4:
- Server returns HTTP 409 Conflict: "Mã chi nhánh đã tồn tại trên hệ thống"; Modal stays open.
- XSS scripts sanitized; Renders safely as text on Table and Leaflet Popups.
- Friendly error alert displayed; Form input state is preserved.
column5: Branch CH01 already exists in database.

column2: Shift Template Master - All Single, Batch, Overnight & Lock Cases
[Happy Path] Verify creating Global Daytime Shift and Overnight Shift crossing midnight
column3:
1. Scope: Global, Name: "Ca Hành Chính", Start: 08:00, End: 17:00, Break: 60m -> Click "Lưu Khung Ca".
2. Scope: Global, Name: "Ca Đêm Toàn Hệ Thống", Start: 22:00, End: 06:00, Break: 30m -> Click "Lưu Khung Ca".
column4:
- Daytime shift: Paid Hours = 8.0h, Night Hours = 0h.
- Overnight shift: Badge "Ca xuyên đêm" displayed, Paid Hours = 7.5h, Night Hours = 6.0h; Both saved successfully.
column5: Account has HR/Operations Admin role; /shifts/master loaded.

column2: [Happy Path / Scope] Verify creating Custom Branch Shift and Batch Shift creation mode
column3:
1. Scope: "Chi nhánh riêng", Branch: "CH01", Name: "Ca Sớm Riêng CH01" (05:30 - 13:30) -> Click Save.
2. Toggle to "Tạo hàng loạt (Batch)": Row 1 (06:00 - 14:00), Row 2 (14:00 - 22:00) -> Click "Lưu Danh Sách Ca".
column4:
- Custom shift created with branchId = CH01, only applied to CH01 roster.
- Batch creation succeeds in single transaction; both shifts render in table without conflicts.
column5: Branch CH01 status is ACTIVE; No conflicting shifts in DB.

column2: [Validation] Verify empty shift name, zero duration (Start == End), and shift under minimum duration (< 1h)
column3:
1. Leave "Tên khung ca làm việc" blank -> Click "Lưu Khung Ca".
2. Set Start Time = 08:00, End Time = 08:00 (Zero duration: 0h).
3. Set Start Time = 09:00, End Time = 09:30 (30 mins duration < 1 hour).
column4:
Submit blocked; Form displays inline errors:
- "Vui lòng nhập tên khung ca làm việc."
- "Giờ kết thúc không được trùng với giờ bắt đầu (ca phải >= 1 giờ)."
- "Thời lượng ca làm việc tối thiểu phải từ 1 tiếng trở lên".
column5: Shift modal is open in Single mode.

column2: [Logic Rule] Verify negative break time, break exceeding shift duration, and missing branch selection
column3:
1. In Break Duration field, input negative value: -15 mins.
2. Set 4h shift (08:00 - 12:00) and Break Duration = 240 mins (or 300 mins).
3. Set Scope = "Chi nhánh riêng" but leave Branch dropdown unselected -> Click Save.
column4:
Form submission blocked with inline errors:
- "Thời gian nghỉ không được nhỏ hơn 0 phút."
- "Thời gian nghỉ phải nhỏ hơn tổng thời lượng ca; Số giờ công phải lớn hơn 0."
- "Vui lòng chọn chi nhánh áp dụng khung ca riêng."

column2: [Conflict & Business Rule] Verify real-time shift overlap detection (Single & Batch) and locked branch restriction
column3:
1. Enter shift overlapping existing shift in same scope (e.g. 08:00 - 12:00 overlaps 06:00 - 14:00).
2. In Batch mode, draft 2 internal overlapping rows (06:00 - 14:00 and 10:00 - 18:00).
3. Select Scope = Custom Branch and pick branch "CH01" (currently LOCKED status).
column4:
- Realtime overlap alert triggers; Save button blocked in both Single and Batch modes.
- Locked branch enforcement blocks submit: "Chi nhánh đang bị tạm khóa. Vui lòng mở khóa chi nhánh trước khi tạo ca riêng."
column5: Shift Ca Sáng exists in DB; Branch CH01 status is LOCKED.
